description: This Java class defines a validator for the VisitType entity in the OpenMRS framework. It implements validation logic to ensure that the properties of a VisitType object, such as name and description, are not null, not empty, and within proper length constraints.

classes.name: VisitTypeValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the VisitType entity to enforce data integrity and validation rules.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks whether the validator supports the class of the object being validated. Returns true if the object is of class VisitType.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the VisitType object, ensuring required fields are present and within correct lengths. Adds errors to the Errors object if validation fails.
